profile.bio: Jafar Tanha is a professor of computer engineering at the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Tabriz, Iran. He received his PhD from the University of Amsterdam in 2013 with a thesis on ensemble approaches to semi-supervised learning, supervised by Hamideh Afsarmanesh and Maarten van Someren, during which he developed semi-supervised self-training and multiclass semi-supervised boosting methods. After the PhD he worked on language-model adaptation for handwritten text recognition with the Dutch Instituut voor Nederlandse Lexicologie (tranScriptorium-era HTR work, co-authored with J. de Does and K. Depuydt). At Tabriz his group works on semi-supervised and deep semi-supervised learning, boosting and ensemble learning, imbalanced data, data-stream learning, fuzzy/semi-supervised clustering, and deep learning applications in medical imaging, sleep staging, and NLP.
